blocks.html:
Where an interior room is provided for the storage of refuse and recyclables, such room shall be completely enclosed by construction that has a fire-resistance rating of not less than 2 hours, with self-closing opening protectives having a fire protection rating of not less than 1 1/2 hours.
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2012/060.
